role: Oil / Short-Horizon strategy-risk review for actual committee position mandates across directional and calendar-spread strategies.

risk_horizon.directional_basis: visible annualized volatility rescaled by square-root of time
risk_horizon.calendar_spread_basis: visible weekly spread-change volatility rescaled to the two-week review window

invariants: Investment Decision owns strategy capital authorization; strategy risk may not recreate a second absolute company-capital ceiling
strategy-risk binding loss and margin limits are expressed relative to allocated strategy capital
stress and margin as percentages of company equity remain visible diagnostics but do not clip a single strategy in this layer
binding company-wide stress and margin aggregation belongs to a future corporate aggregate-risk owner operating across all strategies
risk approval may preserve or reduce committee expected positions but may never create direction, enlarge absolute exposure, or cross through zero
hard market facts are independent of risk-personnel capability
lightweight capability may only perturb soft estimates using information available at the decision cutoff and may not access future truth
risk style may operate more conservatively inside the committee-approved strategy-relative appetite but may not relax the committee policy
risk personnel are scoped by oil and short horizon; directional and calendar spread are coverage objects rather than separate personnel identities
soft stress loss is measured over the two-week review horizon
tail-risk and model-uncertainty multipliers are applied exactly once to a calendar-spread stress estimate
